verification.title: Verification status

banner.UNVERIFIED: Upload a trade licence or national ID to get verified. Until then your job posts stay as drafts.
banner.PENDING: An admin is checking your documents. Your waiting posts will go live as soon as you are approved.
banner.VERIFIED: Your business is verified. You can publish jobs, and every post shows the Verified badge.
banner.REJECTED: Your verification was not approved. Fix the problem below and upload the document again.

verification.changeWarning: Changing the business name or the document after approval sends your profile for review again.
verification.badgeExplain: An admin has checked this employer's trade licence or national ID.

profile.name: Business name
profile.contactPhoneHint: Admins use it to check your business. It is never shown on job posts.
profile.createFirst: Save your business information first, then upload the document.
profile.uploadTitle: Upload a trade licence or national ID
profile.uploadHint: PDF, JPG or PNG (up to 3 MB). Only Kaaj admins can see it.
profile.infoPublish: You can post jobs once your information is verified.

upload.wrongType: Only PDF, JPG or PNG files.
upload.tooLarge: The file is larger than {{mb}} MB.

map.hint: Tap the map to place the pin.

statusReason.REPORTED: Reported by users; hidden until an admin checks it

admin.subtitle: Check each business's document and details, then approve or reject.
admin.select: Choose an employer from the list.
admin.reasonRequired: Give a reason for the rejection.
quickReasons: The business name doesn't match the document
admin.approved: Approved. The employer's waiting posts are now live.
admin.rejected: Rejected. The employer will see the reason.

home.headline: Tell Kaaj what you can do, and get matched to verified work nearby.
home.employers: For employers: post a job in minutes, get verified once, and show the Verified badge on every post.
home.member3: Member-3 · Employer profile and verification · Post and manage jobs

v.wageRange: Must be at least the minimum wage.
v.locationRequired: Pin the location on the map, or mark the job as remote.
v.hoursRequired: Enter both start and end times.
v.phone: Enter a Bangladeshi mobile number, e.g. 01712345678.

code.money-request: asks job seekers for money (a fee or a deposit). Kaaj never allows this.
code.contact-details: phone numbers, e-mail or "WhatsApp only" in the text. Contact goes through Kaaj.
code.unfair-requirement: a requirement about gender, age, religion, marital status or looks. Remove it, or explain why the job needs it.
code.easy-money: promises easy money or work from home.
code.overseas-no-licence: a job abroad without a recruiting licence number.
code.wage-missing: no wage yet. Kaaj always shows the wage.
code.long-day: more than 8 working hours a day. Say how overtime is paid.
code.ai-high-risk: the AI check rated this post high risk.

text.SCREENING_REVIEW: Something in the post needs a person to look at it. It goes live as soon as an admin approves it.
text.SCREENING_BLOCKED: Kaaj does not publish posts that ask job seekers for money. An admin will look at it too.
text.REPORTED: Job seekers reported this post, so it is hidden from search until an admin checks it.
text.REMOVED: This post is no longer shown to job seekers.

report.signInToReport: Sign in to report this post
report.title: Report this post

reasons.FAKE_JOB: The job is fake or not as described

report.detailsPlaceholder: What happened? Please do not write phone numbers.
report.thanks: Thank you. An admin will look at this post.
report.privacy: The employer will not see who reported the post.
report.neverPay: Kaaj never asks job seekers for money. If anyone asks you for a fee for this job, report the post.

moderation.title: Moderation queue
moderation.subtitle: Posts flagged by scam screening and posts reported by users. Most reported and oldest first.
moderation.select: Choose a case from the list.
moderation.note: Note (the employer sees it; also kept in the audit log)
moderation.notePlaceholder: For example: Asking job seekers for a processing fee is not allowed.
moderation.noteRequired: Write a short note to remove the post or suspend the employer.
moderation.confirmSuspend: Suspending signs the employer out at once and stops them signing in. Press again to confirm.
moderation.auditHint: Every decision is written to the audit log. Removing a post warns the people who applied.

done.SUSPEND_EMPLOYER: The post was removed and the employer suspended.
